body: MAHALA, the cunning chieftain who rebuilt the Doviello, leader of the Doviello in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; female; about thirty-five; lean and hard as a huntress. Wind-reddened pale skin, long dark-auburn hair in thick braids woven with small bone beads, sharp amber eyes.
costume: a black leather jerkin laced with rawhide, a charcoal hood half raised, and a heavy black bear-fur mantle clasped at the chest.
signature: A single large BLACK BEAR CLAW on a rawhide cord hangs at her throat, whatever she wears.

vibes.name: Usurper's Smile
vibes.line: her right hand easing the great hall's back door shut behind her, her left hand drawing her hood up; eyes cut sideways back at the hall, cheeks flushed, lips pressed in a tight secret smile; deep blue dusk, first snow, orange firelight from the door slashing across her eyes.
vibes.wears: a charcoal-grey hooded riding cloak over a black leather jerkin laced with rawhide, riding gloves tucked into her belt.

vibes.name: Knife Sleeve
vibes.line: her left hand raising a mead horn to the viewer in a friendly toast, her right hand half hidden in its wide sleeve, turning the bone hilt of a knife between her fingers; a warm smile, steady unsmiling eyes on the viewer; the feast hall at night, hearth firelight.
vibes.wears: a high-necked, long-sleeved dark forest-green wool feast dress with wide embroidered cuffs, a belt of silver and bone plaques, silver rings in her braids.

vibes.name: Camp Rebuilder
vibes.line: her left hand holding a timber beam steady, her right hand driving a wooden peg into its joint with a mallet; glancing up along the beam at the builders above, mouth set; a new Doviello camp on a frosty hillside at bright cold morning, longhouse frames rising in orderly rows.
vibes.wears: an undyed oatmeal wool work tunic with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a sheepskin vest and a leather apron, her braids tied up out of the way.

vibes.name: Pack Thief
vibes.line: both hands hauling her stubborn horse's saddle girth tight; a sly sidelong look and a grin at the tall rider saddling up beside her in shadow, the old warlord's best warrior; black pines at the camp's edge at moonlit midnight, deep snow, breath steaming.
vibes.wears: a white fox-fur hooded mantle over pale grey quilted riding leathers and fur-lined gloves, snow-coloured from head to foot for riding out unseen.
